Title: 486641-2026: France – Engineering and construction works – RN1 - REPAIR OF THE GABARRE BRIDGE: REPAIR AND STRENGTHENING OF THE DECK
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: The tender concerns the repair and strengthening of a road bridge deck including replacement of a movable bridge, technically interesting due to the movable structure. Location in French Guadeloupe (outside DACH/Africa) reduces the priority.
titel: RN1 – Rehabilitation of the Gabarre Bridge: repair and strengthening of the deck
kurzbeschreibung: Replacement of the movable bridge span and strengthening of the deck of the Gabarre Bridge.
umfang: Construction contract for the rehabilitation of a road bridge on the RN1; the works include replacement of the movable span and the safety barriers, as well as repair and strengthening of the deck. The bridge connects Baie-Mahault and Les Abymes. Technical parameters such as spans, total length or width are not specified in the notice. Contract duration 24 months, maximum execution period 14.5 months from the start order.
leistungen: Construction works with integrated design component: execution design, fabrication, implementation of the construction works, coordination of all services as well as traffic management and safety management; replacement of the movable span, renewal of restraint systems, repair and strengthening of the deck.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Road bridge with movable span and deck strengthening, therefore technically clearly more interesting than standard bridges.
• The tender is primarily for construction works, but explicitly requires execution design and overall responsibility for studies, fabrication and implementation; thus there is a relevant design component.
• Rehabilitation and replacement of a movable bridge element fits well with sbp’s expertise in demanding bridges and special structures.
• Project volume of EUR 10 million is economically relevant.
• Location in Guadeloupe is outside the core markets, but the French legal framework and island infrastructure may be strategically interesting.
• Lack of information on spans and structural system limits the priority compared to even more complex major bridges.
honorar_erklaerung: No explicit fee stated. This is a construction contract with an integrated share of execution design, fabrication and construction. For sbp, a potential fee would only arise in the context of cooperation with a contractor or as a subcontractor for structural or execution design; it cannot be reliably quantified on the basis of the notice alone.
auftraggeber: Région Guadeloupe, Av. Paul Lacavé, 97100 Basse-Terre, France; Contact person: Président du Conseil Régional; E-mail: achat@regionguadeloupe.fr; Website: https://www.regionguadeloupe.fr; Procurement platform: https://www.eguadeloupe.com
notes: Contract notice amendment: tender deadline extended from 13.07.2026 to 15.09.2026. No division into lots, but a single contract awarded to one contractor or a consortium with overall responsibility. Environmental and social objectives are mentioned, but without specific technical sustainability criteria in the notice.
